title: Website Feature Flags
description: Build-time feature flags for the comfy.org website. Imported as a JSON module and bundled at build. Mirrors a subset of the main Vue app's remoteConfig flags so the two systems can be unified later.

cloudFreeTier.description: When true, render the Cloud free tier card on /cloud/pricing, the 'TRY COMFY CLOUD FOR FREE' CTA, the 'Start free.' tagline, and the 'Is it really free?' FAQ. When false, all free-tier surfaces are hidden. Mirrors remoteConfig.new_free_tier_subscriptions in the main Vue app.
